name: The Terminator 2029: Deluxe CD Edition
storyline: In Terminator 2029, you play one of Col. John Connor's Special Operations Group tasked to destroy Skynet. You wear Advanced Combat Armor that has configurable slots for weapons which can be swapped on the fly. The gameplay is first-person but you are restricted to the 4 compass directions (e.g. turning left spins you around 90 degrees). The weapons slot feature is well used as you acquire new weapons and attachments as you progress through the game.
summary: The Deluxe CD Edition, released in 1994, includes the original game along with the 1993 expansion pack Operation Scour, giving a total of 34 missions.[6] This edition also includes 330MB of additional mission briefings and character speech, as well as new gameplay music.
